messages:
Maya (PM): heads up — drafting release notes for v1.8.2; deploy window tomorrow 16:00 PDT. Need pin owners, a concise customer blurb, and a rollback decision in this thread. cc @here :eyes:

Kevin (Eng): canary plan: route 10% traffic to dedicated pool for 30m, monitor p95 latency and error rate. fallback to previous pinned model if errors > 2% or latency +30%.

Jordan (Ops): +1. oncall will monitor. rollback criteria proposal: >2% errors sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 450ms for 10m. prefer automated rollback but keep manual abort option.

Maya (PM): sounds good. Sasha — can you eyeball copy for the internal announce and give a one-line customer-facing blurb? Also need confirmation of who owns the pin.

Sasha (Docs): on it. quick suggestion: call out "no user-facing changes" and include a sentence about rollback path. posting snippet shortly.

Kevin (Eng): deploying via deploy-bot. planned commands below — will start canary at 16:05. if anything looks off we abort with /deploy abort <id> and revert to tag v1.8.1.

```
/deploy release/v1.8.2 --canary=10% --duration=30m --region=us-west-2
```

deploy-bot: queued deploy 82b3cd. canary scheduled to start at 16:05 UTC. monitoring endpoints: /health, /generate. metrics published to: redwood.runtime.latency.p95, redwood.errors.rate.

Chris (Oncall): ack. Chris and Nia are on primary watch for the window. Chris will escalate to Jordan if rollback criteria hit. runbook: http://go/runbooks/rn-rollback

Maya (PM): Sasha, here's the draft blurb for RN — please tweak as needed:

Sasha (Docs): Snippet: "Release v1.8.2 — infra optimizations and model pin for better inference stability. No user-facing changes. If we detect elevated errors or latency we will roll back to v1.8.1 per our standard runbook."

Maya (PM): final asks: pin owners please confirm in-thread by EOD and add one-line rationale for the pin. Kevin, can you surface the exact alert thresholds the deploy will honor?

Kevin (Eng): added to deploy config: error_rate_threshold = 0.02, p95_latency_multiplier = 1.3 (i.e., p95 > 1.3x baseline triggers alerts). pushing config to ops repo now.

Jordan (Ops): noted — adding to oncall checklist. scheduling a 10-minute check-in at 16:40 to confirm stability and handoff.

Maya (PM): thanks. @deploy-bot please post a canary summary when it finishes.

deploy-bot: canary started at 16:05 UTC. reporting window open.

deploy-bot: canary complete 16:35 UTC — preliminary metrics OK. ready to promote to 100% in 5m unless a veto is posted.

Maya (PM): no veto from product. proceed.

deploy-bot: promoted to 100% at 16:41 UTC. release tag: v1.8.2. summary: p95 latency +5% vs baseline, errors 0.3% (below 2% threshold). :tada:

Sasha (Docs): prepping internal announcement and RN draft now; will ping for a quick signoff in this thread when ready.

Kevin (Eng): pin owner confirmed — Engineering Infra (Kevin) holds the pin and rollback rationale: stability-first, minimize model drift during infra change.

Maya (PM): perfect, thanks team. closing thread once Sasha posts final RN copy.
